2026/2027 Chinese Government Scholarship - China-Indonesia Scholarship in Higher Education Program
records.official_source: Embassy of the People's Republic of China in the Republic of Indonesia
records.deadline_display: Applications for the 2026/2027 cycle had to be submitted online "before February 8, 2026"; that date has passed and the Embassy has published no date for the following cycle.
records.application_period: 2026/2027 cycle ran from the 2025-10-27 announcement to 2026-02-08; the Embassy then forwarded recommended applications to the China Scholarship Council between 2026-02-09 and 2026-03-05, and results were available in the system in July-August 2026.

records.application_period: 15 November to 15 December each year, for the following academic year. The 2026-2027 call ran 15 November to 15 December 2025.

records.title: ILSC Humanitarian Scholarship
records.deadline_display: Rolling intake - applications are open year-round and no closing date is published
records.application_period: Applications are open year-round. Applicants receive a link to complete ILSC's Online English Placement Test, which must be completed by the deadline stated in that email, and successful candidates are offered the earliest available date.
